tool.name: update_task
tool.description: Update a task's title and/or description for the authenticated user. Returns the task ID, status, and updated title.

user_id.description: User ID extracted from JWT token (automatically provided by authentication)

task_id.description: Unique identifier of the task to update

title.description: New task title (optional, if provided must be non-empty)

description.description: New task description (optional, can be empty string to clear description)

inputSchema.description: At least one of 'title' or 'description' must be provided

task_id.description: Unique identifier of the updated task

status.description: Task completion status (unchanged by this operation)

errors.description: JWT token is missing or invalid
errors.example: Authentication required: Invalid or expired token

errors.description: Task does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated user
errors.example: Task not found: No task with ID aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa

errors.description: Input validation failed (e.g., empty title, no fields to update)
errors.example: Validation error: At least one of 'title' or 'description' must be provided
Database error: Unable to update task

input.description: Milk, eggs, bread, and apples from organic section

input.title: Weekly grocery shopping
input.description: Get items for the week: milk, eggs, bread, fruits, vegetables

notes: This operation only updates title and/or description fields
To change completion status, use the complete_task tool
To change dates, use add_task to create a new task (date updates not supported in this version)
The updated_at timestamp is automatically updated
User isolation is enforced - users can only update their own tasks
